texts.5秒内每进行一次普攻,都会使普攻的闪电链额外连锁一次。最多可增加至5次。: Each Normal Attack performed within 5 seconds makes the Normal Attack's chain lightning chain one additional time. Can increase up to 5 times.
texts.【挥翰成风】释放时增加所有队友15%技能暴击概率物理黑卫额外提升一倍，持续8秒。: When [Swipe Brush like Wind] is cast, increases all allies' Critical Chance (Skill) by 15%, with Physical Blackguards additionally getting double the increase, lasting 8 seconds.
texts.【无垢之境】生效期间，自身每秒受到的治疗效果提升至{6000+1000×天赋等级: While [无垢之境] is active, own healing received per second is increased to {6000 + 1000 × talent level}% Physical Power.
texts.【昭如日月】发射的光束命中时，有20%几率对敌人叠加1层耀斑，耀斑在5秒或目标死: When a beam fired by [昭如日月] hits, 20% chance to apply 1 stack of Flare to the enemy. Flare bursts after 5 seconds or when the target dies, dealing Holy DMG equal to {48% + 8% × talent level} of 司正天座's Max HP to the target and nearby enemies.
texts.【极光电掣】释放时，获得一层雷痕，雷痕叠加到3层，下次释放【极光电掣】时，会在落: When [Aurora Blitz] is cast, gain one stack of Thunder Mark. When Thunder Mark reaches 3 stacks, the next cast of [Aurora Blitz] creates a lightning storm at the landing point for 1.5 seconds, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 16000% Spell Power to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds.
texts.【极光电暴】释放时，额外召唤两枚羽刃协同自己释放光束，羽刃造成的伤害为本体的60: When [Aurora Storm] is cast, additionally summons two featherblades that fire beams together with her; featherblade DMG is 60% of the main body's. (Featherblade DMG can benefit from the Spiritmasters Front bonus)
texts.【气动山河】命中目标时，如果目标已经受【低迷】状态影响，则有100%的几率对目标: When [Force Tremor] hits a target, if the target is already affected by [Enfeebled], 100% chance to apply one stack of [Enfeebled] to all enemy Blackguards or BOSSes near the target.
texts.【淬毒箭雨】命中目标时，使其受到普通攻击和技能的暴击几率提升10%，持续10秒。: When [Scourge Bolts] hits a target, the Crit Chance of Normal Attacks and skills it receives is increased by 10% for 10 seconds.
texts.【烛影破梦】释放同时，给目标施加可吸收6000%法术强度伤害的魔法盾，持续8秒，: When [Dreambreak] is cast, applies a magic shield to the target that absorbs DMG equal to 6000% Spell Power for 8 seconds. If [Lamplight] is currently held, all [Lamplight] is consumed; each 1 point of [Lamplight] consumed increases the magic shield's effect by 10%.
texts.【烽火燎原】命中敌方时，会立刻引爆敌方单位身上的，且引爆时，【炽焰咒】的伤害提升: When [Scorching Rampage] hits an enemy, it immediately detonates what is on the enemy unit, and on detonation, [炽焰咒] DMG is increased by 50%.
texts.【爆破重弩】命中的目标如果带有【中毒】效果，有100%几率会该目标【致盲】，持续:
If the target hit by [Heavy Bolter] has the [Poisoning] effect, 100% chance to [致盲] the target for 6 seconds
[致盲]: reduces Normal Attack Accuracy by 75%. [致盲]: reduces Normal Attack Accuracy by 75%.
texts.【牵魂夺魄】造成的伤害提升100%，且聚集敌人的范围+25%；受到所有伤害有40: [Soul Snatch] DMG dealt is increased by 100%, and its enemy-gathering range +25%; all DMG taken has a 40% chance to be deflected. Deflection: when Deflection triggers, final DMG taken is reduced by 75%)
texts.【猎影风华】命中霜蚀状态的敌人时，有20%+霜蚀层数*10%的几率对目标造成其最: When [Shadow Prowess] hits an enemy in Frost Erosion, there is a 20% + Frost Erosion stacks*10% chance to deal Frost DMG equal to 3% of the target's Max HP; this DMG cannot exceed 1000% of own Spell Power.
texts.【破风】造成伤害时，有10%几率对目标添加一层【炽焰咒】(最多叠加3层)，【炽焰: When [Windbreaker] deals DMG, 10% chance to apply one stack of [炽焰咒] to the target (max 3 stacks). [炽焰咒] explodes after 6 seconds, or when overwritten after reaching the stack cap, dealing Fire DMG equal to 3500% Spell Power to the target and stunning it for 1.5 seconds.
texts.【雪舞纷扬】和【剑势蓄发】释放的新击伤害提升100%。: DMG of the strikes released by [Snow Dance] and [Sword Charging] is increased by 100%.
texts.【雪舞纷扬】持续期问，敌人对自己造成的伤害有35%几率产生偏移，伯移时受到的伤害: While [Snow Dance] lasts, DMG dealt to self by enemies has a 35% chance to be deflected; when deflected, DMG taken is 25% of the original.
texts.【雷鸣抚慰】会对目标施加持续恢复护盾的效果，每秒恢复10%护盾值: [Embrace of Thunderbolt] applies a continuous Shield-restoring effect to the target, restoring 10% of Shield value per second
texts.【雷鸣抚慰】消耗的源力值下降20%: [Embrace of Thunderbolt] Force cost is reduced by 20%
texts.【飞刃】可以弹射1次，弹射时伤害衰减50%；【乱舞手里剑】造成的伤害提升50%。: [Lightning Knife] can bounce 1 time, with DMG reduced by 50% on bounce; [Kunai Flurry] DMG dealt is increased by 50%.
texts.临时解除右手的封印，释放出庞大的魔力，持续5秒。持续期间攻击速度100%，普攻伤: Temporarily releases the seal on the right hand, unleashing immense magic power for 5 seconds. During this time, Attack Speed 100%, Normal Attack DMG increased by 100%, attack range increased by 2 meters, and cannot be knocked back.
texts.为了更好的享受折磨所带来的欢愉，瑞芙荔施放狱火升腾时回复50点怒气: To better enjoy the pleasure brought by torment, Reveille restores 50 Rage when casting Hellfire Eruption
texts.乌西洛蒂的普通攻击命中时有25%%几率偷取目标的法术与物理强度，偷取的数值为自身: When Usilotti's normal attack hits, 25%% chance to steal the target's Spell and Physical Power; the amount stolen is 0.1% of own Spell Power, the steal cap is 5% of own Spell Power, and the stolen target's Power cannot go below 0.
texts.使瑞芙荔在单次施法中有概率释放同一个技能5次。: Gives Reveille a chance to cast the same skill 5 times in a single cast.
texts.冲锋获得10%(额外受到物理精通影响)技能暴击几率。: Charge gains 10% (additionally affected by Physical Mastery) Skill Crit Chance.
texts.凝聚审判之光，对单个敌人进行三段攻击：每段造成1200%法术强度的神圣伤害，并分: Gathers the Light of Judgment to strike a single enemy in three hits: each hit deals Holy DMG equal to 1200% Spell Power, plus additional Holy DMG equal to 1500%/5000%/5000% Physical Power respectively (this skill is not affected by Attack Speed; its DMG counts as Skill DMG.)
texts.凝铸日月光华，持续4秒（每层遗物加成额外+1秒），每0.4秒朝周围随机目标发射一: Forges the radiance of sun and moon for 4 seconds (+1 second per stack of relic bonus), firing a beam at a random nearby target every 0.4 seconds, dealing Holy DMG equal to {3000 + 500 × skill level}% Physical Power. When own Tenacity exceeds 100, every 50 Tenacity reduces the beam interval by 0.05 seconds (minimum 0.2 seconds).
texts.击中不详怨灵的单位，将受到怨灵冰霜气息的诅咒，攻击者的攻击速度将降低40%，持续: Units that hit 不详怨灵 are cursed by the wraith's frost breath: the attacker's Attack Speed is reduced by 40% for 5 seconds
texts.加拉哈德受到圣光的庇佑，减少加拉哈德20%受到的伤害，并且提高50%(额外受到精: Galahad is protected by the Holy Light, reducing Galahad's DMG taken by 20%, increasing the chance to be immune to Blind by 50% (additionally affected by Mental Mastery), and increasing All Attrs resistance by 20% (additionally affected by Mental Mastery).
texts.加拉哈德沐浴在圣光中，加拉哈德在释放必杀技时，额外造成35%(额外受到精神精通影: Galahad bathes in the Holy Light; when Galahad casts his Ultimate Skill, he deals an additional 35% (additionally affected by Mental Mastery) Physical DMG and reduces enemy units' Crit Dmg by 52% for 8 (additionally affected by Mental Mastery) seconds.
texts.加拉哈德舞对距离最远的敌方单位发起冲锋,击退沿途所有单位，并对击退的目标造成10: Galahad launches a Charge at the farthest enemy unit, knocking back all units along the way and dealing Physical DMG equal to 100% Physical Power to the knocked-back targets.
texts.加拉哈德舞起一阵具有破坏性力量的神圣旋风，对自身周围4米圆形范围内的敌人造成24: Galahad whips up a holy whirlwind of destructive power, dealing True DMG equal to 240% Physical Power to enemies within a 4-meter circle around himself and knocking the targets airborne.
texts.印记再生（开放等级250级）：安丽诺每隔6秒(每4点精神精通额外减少1秒)消耗5: Seal Reclamation (unlock level 250): every 6 seconds (each 4 Mental Mastery reduces it by an additional 1 second), Alanah consumes 50 Rage to restore one stack of [Divine Seal]. Each time a [Divine Seal] is destroyed, restores 75 Rage to self.
texts.友方单位每添加一种元素异常状态(冰缓、点燃、感电)，御刃神锋将获得1层【三相之力: Each time an allied unit applies a kind of elemental abnormal status (Chill, Ignition, Electrocution), Vanguard of Valkyrie gains 1 stack of [Trinity Force] (applying the same status repeatedly adds only 1 stack), up to 3 stacks, lasting 5 seconds. Each stack of [Trinity Force] increases Vanguard of Valkyrie's DMG by 16%.
texts.发射一道强大的光束，对前方敌人造成3次4000％法术强度的闪电伤害: Fires a powerful beam, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 4000% Spell Power to enemies in front 3 times
texts.受【寒冷钢铁】伤害的敌人，会被冰冻1.5秒，且所有元素抗性下降5%，冰霜抗性额外: Enemies damaged by [Cold Steel Blast] are inflicted with Freeze for 1.5 seconds, and all elemental resistances are reduced by 5%, Frost Resistance by an additional 5%, lasting 5 seconds. ((This effect can make enemy resistance negative; each 1% of negative resistance increases DMG taken of the corresponding type by 1%)
texts.受到伤害时，会立刻瞬移至血量最低的敌方位置释放一次【舞步轻俏】，伤害为【舞步轻俏: When taking DMG, immediately teleports to the enemy with the lowest HP and casts [Brisk Galop] once, with DMG equal to 100% of [Brisk Galop]; this effect has a 15-second trigger interval. (Not affected by cooldown effects)
texts.受到伤害时，有10%的几率凝聚2具法身，对敌人发射神光进行反击，造成1500%物: When taking DMG, 10% chance to condense 2 Dharmakayas that fire divine light at enemies as a counterattack, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1500% Physical Power; when triggered, also removes Freeze, stun, Charmed and Polymorph effects on self; the counterattack has a Basic interval of 3 seconds.
texts.受到暴击伤害时，有几率对周围的敌方单位造成30000%物理强度的物理伤害，并将其: When taking Crit Dmg, has a chance to deal Physical DMG equal to 30000% Physical Power to nearby enemy units and stun them for 1 second. Trigger chance: 25%. This skill has a minimum trigger interval of 4 seconds and is not affected by Skill Cooldown effects.
texts.受到来自冰封之心伤害的目标，攻击速度下降6%+0.1%*法术精通，(竞技场中攻速: Targets taking DMG from Frozen Heart have Attack Speed reduced by 6%+0.1%*Spell Mastery, (Attack Speed reduction is doubled in the Arena) Normal Attack Crit Chance reduced by 15%+0.2%*Spell Mastery, for 3 seconds.
texts.受到致命伤害时，恢复20%生命，获得1秒无敌，并进入变身状态5秒。一场战斗1次: When taking fatal DMG, restores 20% HP, gains 1 second of Invincible, and enters the transformed state for 5 seconds. 1 time per battle
texts.变身前：在敌人脚下创造烈焰之柱，对波及到的所有敌人造成7500%法术强度的火焰伤: Before transformation: creates a pillar of flame beneath the enemies, dealing Fire DMG equal to 7500% Spell Power to all enemies hit. After transformation: summons a meteor at the enemy's position; on landing, the meteor deals Fire DMG equal to 12000% Spell Power 2 times to all enemies in a small area
texts.变身前：朝敌人释放火球，造成2500%法术强度的火焰伤害。变身后：朝前方释放吐息: Before transformation: launches a Fireball at the enemy, dealing Fire DMG equal to 2500% Spell Power. After transformation: unleashes a breath forward, dealing Fire DMG equal to 5000% Spell Power to all enemies in range.
texts.召唤2只小妖精为芭芭拉作战，攻击造成26%法术强度的火焰伤害，拥有本体40%的生: Summons 2 sylphs to fight for Barbara; their attacks deal Fire DMG equal to 26% Spell Power, and they have 40% of the main body's HP and 100% of its Spell Power. (Max 2 sylphs summoned)
texts.召唤雷云风暴,风暴每秒电击随机敌方单位，造成50%法术强度的闪电伤害。雷云风暴存: Summons a Thunderstorm; the storm shocks a random enemy unit every second, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 50% Spell Power. The Thunderstorm lasts 6 seconds.
texts.司正天座的强韧+{6+天赋等级}点。: 司正天座's Tenacity +{6 + talent level}.
texts.吸收雷电，恢复自身600%法术强度的生命值,并获得【不稳定电流】。当受到10%生: Absorbs lightning, restoring own HP by 600% Spell Power, and gains [Unstable Current]. When taking DMG equal to 10% HP, releases Lightning at a random target within 12 meters, dealing Lightning DMG equal to 10% Spell Power, with a 10% chance to dispel all its buffs and reduce its movement speed by 90% and Attack Speed by 50%.
texts.唤霜海灵入场时，敌方所有黑卫立刻减少怒气值，减少值=(唤霜海灵法术精通-敌方黑卫: When Marine Rime enters the battle, all enemy Blackguards immediately lose Rage; amount reduced = (Marine Rime's Spell Mastery - enemy Blackguard's Spell Negation) X2+200; this effect then triggers once every 20 seconds.
texts.在刀身中凝聚能量，【疾风连斩】将被替换为居合斩每次攻击都会释放大范围的2道斩击，: Gathers energy in the blade; [Gale Slash] is replaced with Iaido Slash, each attack releasing 2 wide-area slashes, dealing Frost DMG equal to 1100% Spell Power to enemies in front.
texts.在空中凝聚巨型飞剑，对目标及其附近的敌方单位造成18000%物理强度的神圣伤害。: Conjures a giant flying sword in the air, dealing Holy DMG equal to 18000% Physical Power to the target and nearby enemy units.
texts.在自身周围召唤1个蛇灵(蛇灵不视作场上单位)蛇灵每隔3秒对10米范围内的敌人造成: Summons 1 serpent spirit around self (the serpent spirit is not counted as a unit on the field); the serpent spirit deals Lightning DMG equal to 36.8% of Florentia's Spell Power to enemies within 10 meters every 3 seconds. (Serpent spirit DMG counts as Normal Attack DMG, and its attack frequency is affected by Attack Speed)
texts.墨凝清影在场时，友方黑卫造成的物理伤害提升12%。: While Blooming Ink Deer is on the field, Physical DMG dealt by allied Blackguards is increased by 12%.
texts.墨凝清影每拥有1.5%的技能暴击概率，可使【仙禽鸣应】造成的伤害提高1%(加成上: For every 1.5% Critical Chance (Skill) Blooming Ink Deer has, DMG dealt by [Fairy Swallow Sings] increases by 1% (bonus cap 100%); also, when [Splash Ink, Paint Fate] deals DMG, restores HP equal to 800% Physical Power to all allies.
texts.墨凝清影绘制仙禽祝福所有队友，当被祝福的队友释放物理技能造成暴击时，该队友触发仙: Blooming Ink Deer paints Fairy Swallows to bless all allies. When a blessed ally casts a Physical skill and lands a crit, that ally triggers the Fairy Swallow blessing, creating a Fairy Swallow that attacks enemies, dealing Physical DMG equal to 6000% of the triggerer's Physical Power; the trigger intervals of different allies are calculated independently. This effect has a 10-second trigger interval, which is affected by Blooming Ink Deer's cooldown effects, down to a minimum of 2 seconds. (Fairy Swallow DMG does not benefit from All DMG and Physical Damage Boost)
texts.夜宴霆光怒气值和最大怒气值+250。: Banquet Thunderlight's Rage and Max Rage +250.
texts.奥瑞安对鲜活生命的渴求使他获得50%重生几率，重生时回复100%生命值: Orion's thirst for living beings gives him a 50% chance to revive, restoring 100% HP on revival
texts.奥瑞安永无止境的贪婪渴望使奥瑞安在暴击时汲取对方的灵魂，每次暴击伤害的15%都将: Orion's endless greed lets him drain the enemy's soul on crits: 15% of each Crit Dmg dealt is converted into Max HP cap.
texts.奥瑞安重生时对当前生命值最少的敌方单位降下【永生诅咒】，自身所受伤害的10%+0: When Orion revives, he brings down [永生诅咒] on the enemy unit with the lowest current HP: 10%+0.5*(Mental Mastery) of the DMG he takes is converted into DMG to this unit, lasting 5+0.5*(Mental Mastery) seconds
texts.奥瑞安重生时，获得【死亡意志】效果。每层【死亡意志】提供20%攻击速度，10%暴: When Orion revives, he gains the [Death Wish] effect. Each stack of [Death Wish] grants 20% Attack Speed, 10% Crit Chance, and 5% DMG boost. [Death Wish] stacks up to 5 times. The DMG boost is additionally affected by Mental Mastery.
texts.婆娑轮舞的技能暴击几率+30: Lady Swan Lake's Skill Crit Chance +30
texts.安丽诺受到玛娜的祝福，使【神圣印记】更加牢固。伤害超过生命上限的15%才可摧毁一: Alanah is blessed by 玛娜, making [Divine Seal] sturdier. Only DMG exceeding 15% of Max HP can destroy a seal, and the seal cap is increased by 1 (an additional 1 per 4 Mental Mastery). When a hero in the team falls below 50% of Max HP, consumes 1 seal to restore 40% of the target's Max HP; each hero can only be healed 1 time within 5 seconds.
texts.安丽诺释放大型治疗，使全体友方黑卫恢复272.0%法术强度的生命值 安丽诺释放大: Alanah casts a large heal, restoring HP equal to 272.0% Spell Power to all allied Blackguards Alanah casts a large heal, restoring HP equal to 400% Spell Power to all allied Blackguards.
texts.安丽诺随机治疗3个血量最低的友方黑卫，为目标黑卫恢复160.0%法术强度的生命值: Alanah heals 3 random allied Blackguards with the lowest HP, restoring HP equal to 160.0% Spell Power to the target Blackguards and granting them [Attack Speed increase] 25% for 5 seconds.
texts.审判使者和自己的幻象们拥有精密的协同作战能力当场上存在多个召唤物时，每存在一个，: Apostle of Judgment and her mirages have precise coordinated combat ability When multiple summons are on the field, each one increases the DMG dealt by Apostle of Judgment and her mirages by 5%, up to 30%.
texts.寒气值达到50点时释放。唤霜海灵凝聚五枚冰枪，短暂延迟后朝目标释放，对一定范围内: Released when Cold value reaches 50. Marine Rime condenses five ice lances which, after a short delay, are launched at the target, dealing Frost DMG equal to 370% Spell Power to enemies within an area.
texts.对10米范围内的1名敌人造成100%法术强度的火焰伤害: Deals Fire DMG equal to 100% Spell Power to 1 enemy within 10 meters
texts.对10米范围内的1名敌人造成60%攻击力的物理伤害: Deals Physical DMG equal to 60% Attack Power to 1 enemy within 10 meters
texts.对10米范围内的1名敌人造成70%法术强度的冰霜伤害。: Deals Frost DMG equal to 70% Spell Power to 1 enemy within 10 meters.
texts.对10米范围内的1名敌人造成73%攻击力的火焰伤害。: Deals Fire DMG equal to 73% Attack Power to 1 enemy within 10 meters.
texts.对10米范围内的3名敌人造成50%法术强度的冰霜伤害。: Deals Frost DMG equal to 50% Spell Power to 3 enemies within 10 meters.
texts.对12米范围内的1名敌人造成200%法术强度的火焰伤害: Deals Fire DMG equal to 200% Spell Power to 1 enemy within 12 meters
texts.对12米范围内的1名敌人造成250%法术强度的冰霜伤害。: Deals Frost DMG equal to 250% Spell Power to 1 enemy within 12 meters.
texts.对12米范围内的4名敌人造成36%攻击力的冰霜伤害: Deals Frost DMG equal to 36% Attack Power to 4 enemies within 12 meters
texts.对1名敌方单位释放魂灯，持续5秒，持续期间，每0.5秒对该敌人及其附近5米范围内: Casts a soul lantern on 1 enemy unit for 5 seconds; during this time, every 0.5 seconds deals Dark DMG equal to 9000% Spell Power to that enemy and all enemy units within 5 meters around it, and also applies an undying effect to the Blackguard with the lowest HP in the team for 3 seconds.
texts.对8米范围内的1名敌人造成400%法术强度的冰霜伤害。: Deals Frost DMG equal to 400% Spell Power to 1 enemy within 8 meters.
